suggested_services_note: Each row is one way this kind of work takes money (one of the master's 28 paths per flow). The owner keeps the services that fit and picks ONE path per service and place. Names and amounts are examples from the profession file, not prices.

suggested_services.name: Trial lesson
suggested_services.example: The main story: Mia's $35 trial lesson in Elena's Spanish 1, Sat Oct 24 at 11:00am (12 seats, 2 trial seats), paid in full when booking. A private lesson at the school ($55), a speaking club ($20) and the 10-week term ($140) are paid this way too.

suggested_services.name: Trial lesson
suggested_services.example: The same $35 trial at a school that takes nothing online: a YES books Mia's seat, and Alex pays at the desk. Adult speaking-club drop-ins can work this way too.

suggested_services.name: Private lesson at home
suggested_services.example: The main story: a $150 private French lesson (60 minutes) at Alex's home with Hugo. A card is saved for the $40 fee, and the $150 is charged when Hugo texts DONE.

suggested_services.name: Private lesson at home
suggested_services.example: The same $150 lesson, paid in full when booking, as some tutors ask. A $150 group class at a host's place is paid in full this way too.

before_times: who is learning: the adult themselves, or the parent's child (the age sets the class)
which language, and the level: never studied, some before, or a fluent speaker who wants a refresher
the goal: travel, school, work, or fun
at the school, by video, or at home
for a class at a host's place: how many learners, their ages, and the place
after_time: anything the teacher should know, like shyness, a first class, or a need for a quiet room (on the secure page)
for a home lesson: the address, and a quiet room with a table and two chairs
for a video lesson: a laptop or tablet with a camera and microphone, in a quiet room
secure_page_only: the parent or guardian's yes that they may book for the child, and the waiver signed for the child
the child's first name and age, any learning or health notes or allergies, and an emergency contact
the pick-up list: the adults who may take the child home
a yes or no for photos or video of the child in class
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or legal guardian for anyone under 18, who books, signs and gets every text; a teen gets a link to send to a parent

stop.words: someone hurt or unwell right now: a hard fall, a head injury, a child who can't stand, fainting, chest pain, trouble breathing

go_on.words: an injury that's healing, or a health condition
go_on.what: the booking goes on; the note goes on the secure page for the teacher; Rosie gives no health advice

go_on.words: a child who is shy, nervous or new to the language
go_on.what: the booking goes on; the note goes to the teacher on the secure page, who keeps a trial learner close

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Waiver and the child's details
steps.when: before the first lesson, signed on the secure page while booking
steps.who: a parent or guardian signs for anyone under 18; adults sign their own
steps.goodFor: the term (1 year), or until the school changes it
steps.result: signed: the booking goes on; not signed in 10 minutes: nothing is booked

steps.name: The pick-up list and the photo yes or no
steps.when: on the secure page while booking; the parent can change them any time
steps.result: only adults on the list take the child home; no answer to photos counts as no

steps.name: Placement for a learner who knows some of the language
steps.when: at the first lesson, by the teacher
steps.result: the teacher places the learner by level; the trial books once the owner OKs it

first_steps_and_forms.prep: for the reminder: come 10 minutes early to check in; a notebook and a pen; for a video lesson, a quiet room, the camera on, and the link 5 minutes early; for a home lesson, a quiet table and two chairs

staff.skills: Spanish, French, Italian and English for speakers of other languages; conversation and exam prep; children's classes only for teachers the owner OKs for children
staff.licenses_or_certificates: no person license for teaching a language unless the state's form names one; the owner may add a teacher's certificate as its own word
staff.supervision: a child is never alone with one adult behind a closed door; two adults in the building for kids' classes (a teacher and the front desk: the school's setting)
staff.who_oks: Sam places learners and OKs private lessons; Pat may OK them too
staff.ratio: up to 10 learners per teacher in a kids' class (the school's setting; a ratio from the state's form wins)

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or legal guardian for anyone under 18, who books, signs and gets every text; a teen gets a link to send to a parent
children_and_age.minors_texts: a teen under 18 gets a link to send to a parent; Rosie never texts the parent first

visit.check_in: at the school: the parent gives the child's check-in code at the desk, or the desk ticks names on the class roster; at a home: the code at the door; at a host's place: the host's contact gives the code; by video: the code is read out at the start
visit.done: the check-in code or the roster tick; for a lesson away from the school, the code or DONE from the teacher
visit.changes_at_visit: a teacher change is texted to every learner booked; a longer private lesson is priced and OK'd first

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: none for a language school or a tutor in most places; where the state's form names a license or registration, the owner adds it as an optional item. Rosie checks no license, certificate, insurance or background check
license.who: the business, for any registration, certificate or insurance it chooses to add
license.ask: optional: any registration number, certificate or insurance the owner wants shown on the listing
license.insurance: optional: liability insurance the owner adds, shown as the owner's word; a host (a school, a library, a company) may ask for proof, and the owner answers it
license.background: optional: the owner may say each teacher who works with children has a background check; shown as the owner's word, never checked by Rosie

never_in_a_text: a child's last name, age, learning or health notes, allergies, pick-up list or photos never go in a text; texts to the parent may use the child's first name only; texts to Sam or the staff carry no child details at all: they name the parent and the class, and link to the secure page
